captions_note: the only words of the effect are the tiny print on the film's edge; the reel's captions run over the picture
in_a_reel: ON is the first word of the line (old times, film, memories). Start the slot at least 0.1 s before it and give it 1.5 s or more
BACK = 'auto' cuts back just before the slot ends. BACK = None only when the slot ends on a cut of the reel
the slot's sound must hold the voice: the soundtrack strip is drawn from it. EDGE_PRINT goes in the reel's language
steps: edit ON and EDGE_PRINT in the CLIP block
run build.py SAFE=1      # bakes the look, draws the soundtrack strip from the voice, prints the times
run check.py      # frame count, plain first frame, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
